topic: Brazilian localization support access and review
summary_markdown:
The conversation addresses the need for Brazilian language localization support. [p12] recommends contacting Charles ([email@allunite.com]) directly for any localization needs, noting his availability and time zone differences.

[p8] requested access for Charles to correct translations, also mentioning a request from Sergio. [p12] agreed to grant access but required being informed of the scope of work for control purposes. However, [p12] noted that while Charles is new, he can handle basic tasks and may need assistance with terminology, which Sergio knows well.
decisions: Access will be granted for localization review, pending coordination.
action_items: Someone needs to inform [p12] about the scope of work before granting access.
